contexts.text: The pleasures originating in lusts are to be restrained...
As they cannot be restrained by internal fear, they are kept in bonds by external fear.
So long as they are in this world, they are restrained through fear...
To keep in bonds, means to check and restrain; spiritual bonds are affections, for these are what lead man, and what restrain him.
In the other life the interiors are no longer restrained by external things...
They are separated from the external things which had restrained and checked them in this world. HH 507.
Still their insanity is restrained by the Lord.
The Spirit now acts from his nature, which cannot be restrained or broken except through punishments.
Unless the same Lord restrained the assaults of the Hells...
Whereby the general endeavour issuing from the Hells is checked and restrained...
The only means of restraining the violence and fury of those who are in the Hells, is the fear of punishment.
The reason why torments in the Hells are permitted, is that evils cannot be otherwise restrained and subdued.
That with some the love of the sex cannot be wholly restrained... without injury. Explained.
These things are not said to those who can restrain the heat of lust.
That the doing of evil, in both worlds, has been restrained by laws, otherwise society in both would perish. General article. TCR 498:2.
On those who restrain the turpitudes of Spirits.
